subject: website
name: Bird Is The Word Boat Tours
summary: A boat-tour site for Negril, Jamaica: plain HTML, CSS and one readable script, served as written, so the page is its own public source (no licence file). It runs no third-party code on its own; its YouTube video loads only when the visitor presses play and its booking forms open WhatsApp on submit, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: its stylesheet imports Google Fonts when the page opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Imported by the stylesheet when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
